result.title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
result.summary: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. Members share backgrounds while evidence, patient states, or task goals change; each has its own medical scoring requirements. A 70-person medical team annotates and reviews the simulated cases and their rubrics. Human review of 700 full-context responses from the original evaluation yields 90.5% pooled agreement with the original automated judgments at the rubric-item level. We report full-context and query-only results for seven general-purpose models and Ant Afu. Across the eight systems, full- query differences range from 11.83 to 31.76 case points and from 10.87 to 38.97 geometric cluster points. GPT-6-Astra leads both full-context metrics at 75.03 and 60.42, followed by Claude-Opus-5-5 and Ant Afu. Cross-condition differences describe score changes under the reported evaluation settings. Response comparisons reveal failures in checking historical information, expressing uncertainty when warranted, and ensuring recommendations respect required conditions. The resource supports model comparison and targeted follow-up evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 HealthCLBench 中文健康对话基准，包含 328 个受控案例簇、1,103 个案例与 4,931 条成员级评分细则：成员共享背景，但在证据、患者状态或任务目标上发生变化，用于评测八套系统的全上下文与仅查询表现及人工一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「受控案例簇＋成员级细则」的可控变体设计可能可供核查，用于判断答案是否真正依赖某一具体证据（类似视觉证据消融与贡献分配），但本文无视觉输入与 latent 状态，联系仅为评价思路层面的类比。
